discoveries.problem: A batch import replayed after interruption applies the same event twice
discoveries.mechanism: Membership set checked before mutation; remember() refuses a seen checkpoint
discoveries.invariant: Each identity is applied at most once
discoveries.assumptions: Callers supply identities that are stable across restarts
discoveries.falsifier: Replaying a completed batch changes the total

discoveries.problem: Unlock flows need to know whether an unlock was new, not just record it
discoveries.mechanism: remember() returns a first-seen boolean, so one call both records and reports novelty
discoveries.invariant: The caller learns whether this call changed state without a second lookup
discoveries.assumptions: Callers act on the signal instead of discarding it
discoveries.target_need: hypothesis: expose a replay counter so operators see how much of a resumed batch was already applied
discoveries.falsifier: Operators never use the count, or counting still needs a second lookup
discoveries.rationale: Beyond the donor's purpose: the return value is an observability hook, not only deduplication

discoveries.problem: Totals above 2**53 lose precision with binary floats
discoveries.mechanism: Exact BigInt reduction over decimal strings
discoveries.assumptions: Inputs are integer minor units written as strings

discoveries.problem: Values crossing a JSON or JavaScript boundary silently become floats
discoveries.mechanism: Amounts and totals stay decimal strings at every interface; exact integers exist only inside
discoveries.invariant: Serialized state never holds a binary float amount
discoveries.assumptions: Every consumer parses strings rather than JSON numbers
discoveries.target_need: hypothesis: checkpoint files stay exact when another runtime reads them
discoveries.falsifier: A consumer that reads the checkpoint as JSON numbers loses digits
discoveries.rationale: Beyond arithmetic: a representation rule for the checkpoint format

seam.exports_consumers: Donor remember(seen, checkpoint) has one caller shape; ReplayTotal.add re-expresses it
seam.closure: Donor unit uses only a built-in set; nothing is imported from the fixture
seam.initialization: Donor relies on a caller-created set; ReplayTotal creates its ledger in __init__
seam.state_transactions: Donor mutates the caller's set; ReplayTotal owns entries and validates before mutating
seam.resources_lifetime: No files, sockets or handles in either side
seam.concurrency_cancellation: Single-threaded calls; caller serializes access; no async
seam.errors_retries: Donor never raises; product raises ValueError before mutation and returns False on a same-value retry
seam.serialization: Donor keeps no format; product snapshots a versioned dictionary
seam.permissions_effects: In-memory computation only; checkpoint I/O belongs to the caller
seam.tests: Frozen independent oracle plus disconnected-dedupe control
seam.licensing: Locally authored fixture; no external source copied
